scope: Repository import adapters, embedded Art Ceramic export, and current AbaElMozahem ceramic products endpoint; not a physical stock verification.

materialClassification.renderedCollection: All imported records are currently assigned ceramics by the two adapters. This is not independent material certification.

limits: All image URLs were counted, not all checked for availability. The 17 selected swatch images were downloaded and decoded successfully.
Source records remain staged/needs-human-review in the adapters.
No supplier stock, complete porcelain coverage, natural marble inventory or every tile type has been verified.
The old material showcase was demonstrative; the new material rail links actual source products.
Aba catalogue is fetched at runtime and cached; count may differ if that fetch fails or the source changes.
